title: Manifest, Resources, and Application Identity Quick Check

questions.prompt: Which value identifies an installed application to Android?
questions.explanation: The selected variant application ID becomes the package-manager identity.

questions.prompt: Match each manifest concept to its purpose.
questions.explanation: Each declaration contributes a different system-visible contract.

questions.prompt: Every qualified resource should normally have a compatible default resource.
questions.explanation: A default lets configurations without the specific qualifier resolve the resource safely.
